title: Remove dynamic counts from committed Hunch documentation
context: Hunch documentation (decision/bug/constraint/policy counts) was auto-generated via MCP server, but multiple tool installations created drift. In-tree CLI and globally-installed versions produced different outputs, causing stale counts in committed docs.
decision: Strip specific counts ("257 decisions, 2 bugs, 28 constraints, 21 components, 3 policies, 1 open findings") from Hunch headers in AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and IDE rule files. Keep only the high-level description. Direct users to query hunch_* MCP tools for current state instead of reading committed snapshots.
consequences: Committed documentation remains stable across tool version changes
Eliminates coordination burden of keeping counts in sync with in-tree generator
Users must consult MCP tools directly for current Hunch statistics rather than reading docs
alternatives_rejected: Maintain counts manually in committed docs (unsustainable, error-prone drift)
Pin global tool version to match in-tree (inflexible, shifts burden to environment setup)
Regenerate docs in CI on every commit (tight coupling, makes docs a derived artifact)
